## Episode Thesis

A guest from EY's IPO advisory practice discusses the recovery of the Swedish and global IPO market in H1 2026, noting the US (led by SpaceX) vastly outpaced Europe in listing volumes. The conversation covers how quality and sector focus of new listings has shifted toward defense, AI/tech, and aerospace, with cautious optimism for a modest H2 2026 in Stockholm, citing Silex and last year's VerySure as reference points for size and reception.
